# LOG — Observability

- Owner: `ticonnect-logging`
- Stage: 1
- Layer: `leaves`
- Component graph: [generated/components/log.md](generated/components/log.md)

## Purpose

Parse log configuration, build tracing subscribers, route output, and enforce redaction rules.

## Boundary

Leaf crate. No settings, core, domain, or network dependency. Runtime passes validated log settings.

## Owned state

- global tracing subscriber

## Invariants

- `INV-CFG-1` — Configuration lives only in config.toml and SQLite stores no configuration. Test: crates/settings/src/tests.rs and crates/daemon/tests/storage.rs
- `INV-CFG-2` — Config writes are locked and atomically replace the file. Test: crates/settings/src/tests.rs
- `INV-SEC-1` — No secret, key, message body, or keystroke is logged by default. Test: planned: logging redaction tests
- `INV-STAGE-1` — Every stage demo uses only components from that stage or earlier stages. Test: cargo xtask systems --check
- `INV-STATE-1` — Every persistent store has exactly one owner component. Test: cargo xtask systems --check

## Failure semantics

- invalid level or format returns typed error
- initialization is guarded
- no secrets in output
